title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_diario_de_uma_vegana_by_alana_rox_x1fm3 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_diario_de_uma_vegana_by_alana_rox_x1fm3' contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or run.
